parrafo.es: C&G Event Center es un salon privado en Hollywood, FL para quinceañeras, baby showers, bodas, graduaciones y cualquier celebracion. Decoracion a medida y atencion directa del equipo en cada detalle.
parrafo.en: C&G Event Center is a private venue in Hollywood, FL for birthdays, baby showers, weddings, graduations and any celebration. Custom decor and hands-on service from the team for every detail.

parrafo_1.es: C&G Event Center es un salon privado en Hollywood que transforma el espacio segun cada evento: desde cumpleaños tematicos hasta bodas y graduaciones, con decoracion propia para cada ocasion.
parrafo_1.en: C&G Event Center is a private venue in Hollywood that transforms the space for every event: from themed birthdays to weddings and graduations, with custom decor built for each occasion.

parrafo_2.es: El equipo, liderado por Chanel, acompaña cada proyecto desde la primera idea hasta el dia de la fiesta.
parrafo_2.en: The team, led by Chanel, walks with every client from the first idea to the day of the party.

texto.es: Nos cuentas la fecha, el tipo de evento y cuantos invitados esperas.
texto.en: Tell us the date, the type of event and how many guests to expect.

texto.es: Confirmamos si el salon esta libre ese dia y te damos el detalle del paquete.
texto.en: We confirm if the venue is open that day and walk you through the package.

texto.es: Definimos colores y tema juntos, y el equipo arma el salon a tu medida.
texto.en: We define colors and theme together, and the team sets up the venue to match.

texto.es: Llegas y encuentras todo listo: solo queda disfrutar la fiesta.
texto.en: You arrive and find everything ready: all that is left is to enjoy the party.

nota.es: Cada paquete se cotiza segun el tipo de evento y la cantidad de invitados. Llamanos para el detalle.
nota.en: Every package is quoted based on the type of event and guest count. Call us for the details.

texto.es: Decoracion tematica completa, desde globos hasta el fondo para fotos.
texto.en: Full themed decor, from balloon arches to the photo backdrop.

texto.es: Ambientacion suave y elegante, pensada para celebrar en familia.
texto.en: Soft, elegant styling, built to celebrate with family.

texto.es: Montaje elegante con mesa principal, flores y backdrop a medida.
texto.en: An elegant setup with a head table, flowers and a custom backdrop.

texto.es: El salon se adapta para celebrar logros academicos y reuniones de empresa.
texto.en: The venue adapts to celebrate academic milestones and company gatherings.

pie.es: ¿Tu celebracion no esta en la lista? Llamanos igual, armamos el salon para tu ocasion.
pie.en: Do not see your celebration on the list? Call us anyway, we will set up the venue for your occasion.

items.quote: Professional, accommodating and perfect execution; those are just a few words I will use to describe the venue owners and how they took care of us. From the inception of this project until the day of our daughter's college graduation party.

Once in a while you meet someone that takes care of you like they are family. I hosted a baby shower at C & G Event and was just blown away with the amazing customer service, great deals, beautiful set up for my event!
My vision truly came to life in this venue, and I couldn't be more thankful for Chanel and this entire experience! My leopard print party turned out even better than my Pinterest board.
